name: HoseTrack
tagline: Record every hydraulic hose failure and see where the problems start.
audience: Mining contractors, hydraulic workshops, mine maintenance departments and fleet operators.
summary: HoseTrack helps maintenance teams keep proper records of hydraulic hose failures, replacements and servicing, so the same breakdowns stop repeating.
features: Log a hose failure against a machine, with the hose type and size
Attach photos of the failed hose
Keep machine lists and your own choice lists
See reports with charts of what is failing
Records are stored on the phone
Can be connected to a company system such as Pronto, through a service built by the company's IT team
why: Over time the records show which hoses fail repeatedly and where breakdowns come from, which supports preventative checks during servicing.

name: FreshMart
tagline: Simple stock and sales for the grocery shop owner.
audience: Individual grocery shop owners who run one shop.
summary: FreshMart helps a shop owner see what is in stock, record what comes in and what is sold, and spot items that are running low.
features: Two simple modes: Stock in and Sell
Speak to the app to record items
Quickly filter products that are low or out of stock

name: PowerPay
tagline: Buy prepaid electricity from your phone.
summary: PowerPay is a prototype that lets a customer buy prepaid electricity and report faults from their phone, while staff follow sales and faults on their own dashboard.
features: Customer app: buy electricity and confirm the purchase
See your purchase history and account
Report a fault and check its progress
Staff dashboard: sales per day and sales by payment network
Staff dashboard: see reported faults and update their status
